title: Micro-handshake stewardship census — May 2026
content: Purpose: one-page, lightweight tracker to map temporary owners, expected handoffs, and immediate gaps for short-lived cross-team activities (weekend surge, pilot integration, ad-hoc outage mitigation). Use this as a working ledger; will be snapshot-sent to #ops-handoffs and product-ops.
rows_text:
ROW-HEADER: item | current steward | backup | region | est effort (hrs) | target date | status | blocking-ticket | escalation-channel | notes
1 | weekend fallback route mapping | Daniel K. | Morgan L. | us-west | 2 | 2026-05-15 | in_progress | ENG-2679 | #sre-oncall | need orthogonal test vectors from runtime (PR 482). Daniel to coordinate with SRE sandbox.
2 | pilot onboarding checklist (Acme Corp) | Aisha P. | Priya S. | eu-west | 4 | 2026-05-18 | blocked | PROD-2417 | #solutions-se | waiting model artifact (S3 link) + KMS creds. Priya to raise onboarding ticket to infra.
3 | short-term capacity pledge (reserve GPUs for demo) | Hector A. | Morgan L. | us-east | 1 | 2026-05-16 | open | FIN-332 | #platform-alloc | need sign-off from finance for burst charge cap. estimate $480 for 4hrs on p3-type.
4 | latency sampling owners (ad-hoc) | Morgan L. | Aisha P. | global | 3 | 2026-05-20 | in_progress | OBS-908 | #observability | Morgan to drop sampling query and tag traces with route-id; ask: include kv-cache metrics?
5 | temporary API key rotation (demo keys) | Priya S. | Daniel K. | global | 0.5 | 2026-05-14 | done | SEC-710 | #security | rotation completed, secrets pushed to vault, slack note posted in #sec-alerts.
6 | fallback-model compatibility check | Aisha P. | Hector A. | eu-west | 2 | 2026-05-19 | in_progress | ENG-2710 | #serving-runtime | quick smoke on quantized variant failed for seq_len 2048; follow up with applied-ml.

Quick tallies: total open rows: 3 | total est effort open (hrs): 7.5 | highest blocker class: infra/credentials

Open questions / rough decisions needed:
- Do we accept temporary finance cap for Acme demo (Hector owns owner-ask to finance by 2026-05-15)?
- Should latency sampling include prefix-cache miss dimension? (Morgan to propose by 2026-05-16).
- Is fallback-model rollout gated on quant-compat tests passing or on smoke-level acceptance? Product to decide (Aisha to propose criteria).

Meeting notes (05/13 sync):
- Agreed: use this sheet as canonical small-scope handoff for short windows (<7 days).
- Action: Priya to open infra ticket for KMS access; timeline slipped by ~48hrs.
- Action: Daniel to coordinate live test w/ SRE for fallback route before 05/15 09:00 PDT.

Next steps / owners (short):
- Hector: finalize finance cap request + cc finance lead (email template below) by 05/15 EOD.
- Morgan: push sampling query and example dashboard panel; share link to CONFLUENCE micro-dashboard.
- Aisha: propose acceptance criteria for fallback-model canary; schedule 30m decision slot 05/16.
- Priya: follow up infra ticket and post KMS ETA in thread.

Email template for finance cap request (copy/paste):
Subject: temporary GPU burst cap request — Acme demo (May 16)
Body: Hi Finance, requesting temporary $500 burst cap to reserve 4 GPUs for a 4hr demo on 2026-05-16. Owner: Hector Alvarez (hector@redwood.ai). Please advise approval path.

Quick reference links (put in slack message):
- tracker: {this doc}
- onboarding PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding/pull/91
- sample infra ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-542

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- consider adding a small boolean column 'requires-ops-runbook' for future pivot.
- maybe auto-export to confluence summary during handoffs.

Snapshot summary (to paste into slack):
Micro-handshake stewardship census — snapshot 2026-05-18: 6 items tracked; 3 open; primary blockers: infra creds + finance cap; owners: Aisha/Daniel/Hector/Morgan/Priya. Please see tracker and comment if you want to take ownership of any open rows.
